mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video ( uid, title, source_type, visibility, duration, mc_id, sc_id, tags, description, cover_url, cover_key, video_url, video_key, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{uid}, #{title}, #{sourceType}, #{visibility}, #{duration}, #{mcId}, #{scId}, #{tags}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{coverKey}, #{videoUrl}, #{videoKey}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT vid, uid, title, source_type, visibility, duration, mc_id, sc_id, tags, description, cover_url, video_url, status, created_at, deleted_at FROM video WHERE vid = #{vid}
SELECT vid, uid, title, source_type, visibility, duration, mc_id, sc_id, tags, description, cover_url, video_url, status, created_at, deleted_at FROM video WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
